summary: This panel from the GDC Festival of Gaming featuring Hidemaro Fujibayashi (Breath of the Wild director), Takuhiro Dota (technical director), and Satoru Takizawa (art director) explains how The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild rethinks Zelda conventions to enable expansive player freedom. The speakers describe two core design principles—rediscovering the essence of Zelda and breaking conventions—and outline how a unified system of game physics and a “chemistry engine” power multiplicative gameplay, where objects, environments, and player actions interlock to produce countless possible outcomes. The talk also covers runes like Stasis and Magnesis, climbing dynamics, prototyping (including a 2D Zelda concept), and the art-direction trajectory influenced by Wind Waker HD, culminating in platform considerations for Wii U and Nintendo Switch and the philosophy of providing players with tools to invent their own solutions.”
title: Breath of the Wild: Rediscovering the Essence and Breaking Conventions through Multiplicative Gameplay
